services.desc: Our Bear Glacier Lunch and Paddle offers a perfect blend of adventure and relaxation. It includes an unforgettable kayak tour among stunning icebergs and a gourmet meal in the heart of Alaska’s wilderness. Whether you’re looking for a leisurely paddle or a more active experience, the level of activity is entirely up to you. This one-of-a-kind guided excursion caters to all adventure levels, allowing you to explore at your own pace while enjoying breathtaking views. Experience the adventure of a lifetime with a scenic helicopter flight to Bear Glacier. blurb: Guests fly in helicopters seating 3 or 4 passengers, landing on glaciers for dog sledding or hiking and picnics. Tours include glacier dog sledding with husky puppies, scenic flights, lunch and paddle excursions, overnight stays at remote yurts, and elopement packages. The company is locally owned with extensive experience and a perfect safety record.
